queries.query: Texcoco de Mora Mexico official cadastral parcel map catastro municipality
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Municipality of Texcoco Catastro page and its local cadastral service contact, including certification of cadastral key/value, block-plan certification, and cadastral-identification services. The page did not expose a parcel viewer or anonymous parcel feature endpoint.

queries.query: Texcoco de Mora México mapa catastral predios catastro sitio oficial
queries.result: First-party Spanish discovery confirmed the Ayuntamiento's Dirección de Suelo Sostenible y Catastro, its catastro contact, and an official page titled 'Localiza Aqui tu Predio'. The embedded map is a public Google My Maps map labelled San Bernardino and is not a qualified citywide cadastral parcel service; no safe parcel ID plus polygon response was obtained.

registryEvidence.localCustodian: Municipio de Texcoco, Dirección de Suelo Sostenible y Catastro; the official municipal pages list cadastral certification, cadastral-identification, and block-plan services and provide catastro@texcoco.gob.mx and telephone extension 2060.
registryEvidence.officialPublicMap: The municipality hosts a page titled 'Localiza Aqui tu Predio', but its embedded Google My Maps resource is labelled San Bernardino and is not evidence of a Texcoco cadastral parcel API or citywide parcel coverage.
